Comparison of Functionally Graded Hip Stem Implants with Various Second-Generation Titanium Alloys

High Hip Implant & Femoral Stem openalex Direct Read now simulation_case
Tawakol A. Enab, Noha Fouda, Ibrahim Eldesouky DOAJ (DOAJ: Directory of Open Access Journals) 2021-07-01 10.22055/jacm.2020.32964.2115
单位: Production Engineering and Mechanical Design Department, Faculty of Engineering, Mansoura University, P.O. 35516, Mansoura, Egypt
通讯: Tawakol A. Enab @ Production Engineering and Mechanical Design Department, Faculty of Engineering, Mansoura University, P.O. 35516, Mansou
相关性: 该论文直接评估了功能梯度髋关节柄对股骨应力分布和应变能的影响，与用户研究方向高度相关。
边界: This paper does not report micromotion values or contact/friction modeling at the bone-implant interface.
动机· 为减少应力遮挡并避免有害元素，提出功能梯度髋关节柄设计。
方法· 使用3D有限元模拟，对比不同钛合金功能梯度柄在阶梯载荷下的性能。
结果· 功能梯度柄增加了股骨皮质骨和松质骨的应变能与应力，降低了轴向刚度。
验证· 通过有限元数值模拟对比不同材料模型。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To reduce stress shielding and avoid adverse tissue reactions from conventional implant materials, functionally graded hip stems with second-generation titanium alloys are proposed.
Method· A 3D finite element simulation was performed on virtual implantation of various functionally graded hip stems under dynamic stair descent loading.
Result· Functionally graded stems increased strain energy and von Mises stress in cortical and cancellous bone while reducing axial stiffness compared to solid Ti6Al4V stems.
Validation· Numerical simulation comparing multiple material models under a single loading scenario.

Result· The CFD-guided parameter selection enabled stable jetting and organized pattern printing with high accuracy.
Validation· Experimental validation showed jet length deviation below 14% and successful printing of alphabetic patterns.

通讯: Bidyut Pal @ Department of Mechanical Engineering, Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology, Shibpur, Howrah, West Beng [推断]
相关性: 该论文通过有限元分析和理论模型研究了Ti-25Nb多孔结构的力学性能与孔隙率的关系，旨在减少应力遮挡，但缺乏LPBF制造和实验验证。
边界: No LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration data.
动机· 建立Ti-25Nb多孔结构力学性能与孔隙率关系，以减少应力遮挡
方法· 对七种孔隙率的BCC结构进行有限元分析，并用Gibson-Ashby和指数模型预测刚度
结果· 孔隙率50%-70%可模拟皮质骨力学性能

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To establish the relationship between mechanical properties and porosity of Ti-25Nb BCC porous structures for orthopedic implants to reduce stress shielding.
Method· Finite element analysis was conducted on BCC structures with seven porosity levels (29%-79%) under tension, bending, and torsional loads, and the Gibson-Ashby and exponential regression models were used to predict stiffness.
Result· Porosity in the range of 50%-70% was found to mimic the mechanical properties of cortical bone.
Validation· The analytical model predictions matched the FEA results closely.

单位: Biomanufacturing and Rapid Forming Technology Key Laboratory of Beijing, Department of Mechanical Engineering, Tsinghua University, Beijing, 100084, China
通讯: Mo-han Hao @ Biomanufacturing and Rapid Forming Technology Key Laboratory of Beijing, Department of Mechanical Engineering, Tsinghua
相关性: 该论文研究了Ti6Al4V的混合预热增材制造工艺，但对多孔结构、疲劳性能和表面粗糙度等生物医学植入物关键指标未涉及。
边界: This paper focuses on process optimization for Ti6Al4V but does not include porous structures, fatigue testing, surface roughness, or osseointegration analysis relevant to biomedical implants.
动机· 传统EBM和SLM工艺难以获得综合性能优良的Ti6Al4V，需开发混合预热策略。
方法· 提出了电子束与激光混合预热结合选择性熔化的两种策略（EBM-LT和SLM-HT）。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Conventional EBM and SLM processes yield suboptimal properties for Ti6Al4V, motivating a hybrid preheating approach.
Method· Two hybrid preheating strategies combining electron beam and laser (EBM-LT and SLM-HT) were proposed and implemented.
Result· EBM-LT and SLM-HT improved ultimate tensile strength while reducing elongation compared to standard processes.
Validation· Tensile tests, density measurements, and microstructural analysis were used to validate the performance.

动机· 研究3D打印髋臼假体的骨整合效果是否优于传统假体。
方法· 对翻修取出的3D打印与传统假体进行组织学分析，量化骨附着与长入指标。

Motivation· The study aims to compare osseointegration between retrieved 3D-printed and conventional acetabular implants to determine if the porous structure enhances bony fixation.
Method· Retrieved implants were macroscopically and histologically analyzed using undecalcified sections and line-intercept quantification of bone attachment, ingrowth, contact, and depth.
Result· 3D-printed implants showed significantly greater bone ingrowth (63% vs 37%) compared to conventional implants across all outcome measures.
Validation· Validation was performed via retrieval analysis of human implants with histological examination and statistical comparison of matched groups.

Motivation· To investigate the influence of nodes and building orientation on the fatigue behavior of L-PBF Ti6Al4V lattice structures at the sub-unital element level.
Method· Single strut specimens with a central node were designed and manufactured via L-PBF in four building orientations (90°, 45°, 15°, 0°) and subjected to fatigue testing.
Result· The fillet radius at the node and the building orientation significantly affect the fatigue strength of the lattice sub-unital elements.
Validation· Experimental fatigue testing was conducted on as-built specimens.

Amirhossein Arzani, Jian-Xun Wang, Roshan M. D'Souza Physics of Fluids 2021-07-01 10.1063/5.0055600
单位: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Northern Arizona University 1 , Flagstaff, Arizona 86011, USA
通讯: Amirhossein Arzani @ Department of Mechanical Engineering, Northern Arizona University 1 , Flagstaff, Arizona 86011, USA
相关性: 该论文展示了PINN在血流动力学中的应用，其方法可迁移至植入物力学代理建模，但未涉及固体力学或约束优化。
边界: This paper focuses on cardiovascular hemodynamics (fluid dynamics) rather than solid mechanics or implant design, and does not address multi-objective optimization or uncertainty quantification in a structural context.
动机· 近壁血流和壁面剪切应力难以精确量化
方法· 利用物理信息神经网络融合稀疏测量数据与Navier-Stokes方程
结果· 即使边界条件未知，也能从稀疏速度数据准确重建WSS

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Accurate quantification of near-wall blood flow and wall shear stress is challenging due to uncertainty and limited resolution in patient-specific models.
Method· Physics-informed neural networks integrate sparse velocity measurements with the Navier-Stokes equations to reconstruct flow fields without full boundary condition knowledge.
Result· The PINN framework accurately predicts wall shear stress from sparse interior data, even when inlet/outlet boundary conditions are unknown.
Validation· Validation is performed on idealized stenosis and aneurysm simulation cases.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To radiologically compare cement mantle quality and alignment of a polished tapered cemented femoral stem inserted through the anterior versus posterior approach.
Method· A retrospective comparative study of 115 consecutive hybrid THA or hemiarthroplasties using a collarless polished taper-slip stem, assessing cement mantle quality and thickness on radiographs.
Result· No significant differences in Barrack grade or alignment between approaches; adequate cement mantle achieved in 77.6% (anterior) and 86% (posterior); higher BMI, left side, and Dorr C morphology were risk factors for poor cement mantle.

Motivation· To investigate the prevalence and characteristics of fretting and corrosion at the modular liner-shell interface of dual mobility hip implants.
Method· Sixty retrieved modular dual mobility liners were scored for fretting and corrosion; corrosion products from three severely corroded implants were analyzed using SEM and FTIR.

Validation· Clinical retrieval analysis with histological examination of periprosthetic tissues.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To compare low-speed drilling without irrigation against conventional drilling for dental implant osteotomy preparation.
Method· A systematic review following PRISMA guidelines, including in vitro, animal, and clinical studies with bias assessment.
Result· Low-speed drilling maintained temperatures below 47°C and yielded greater harvested bone quantity with better cellular properties, but osteotomy precision evidence was limited to one in vitro study.
Validation· Validation relied on qualitative synthesis of included studies with risk-of-bias assessment across different study designs.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To develop a drug-free bioresorbable stent that minimizes the duration of coronary artery scaffolding and avoids permanent foreign material.
Method· A first-in-man trial was conducted using a lactic acid stereocopolymer stent with 98% l-lactyl units, followed by clinical and imaging assessments over 36 months.
Result· No deaths, myocardial infarctions, or stent thromboses occurred; the stent dismantled after 3 months and was nearly fully resorbed by 2 years, but neointimal hyperplasia was slightly greater than with drug-eluting stents.
Validation· Validation via clinical outcomes and optical coherence tomography imaging.

Method· Zirconia disks were modified by acid etching, bioactive glass coating, or TKP-AA hydrogel coating, and human osteoblast Saos-2 cells were cultured to assess proliferation, differentiation, and mineralization.
Result· TKP-AA hydrogel promoted highest proliferation, while bioactive glass coating enhanced mineralization, and all modifications improved osteoblast differentiation compared to unmodified zirconia.
Validation· Validation involved SEM imaging, confocal microscopy, cell viability assays, ALP activity, and alizarin red staining in an in vitro model.

Motivation· To investigate whether the 'July effect' (trainee turnover) influences hospital length of stay after primary total hip or knee arthroplasty.
Method· Retrospective cohort study using the ACS-NSQIP database (2006-2012) with multivariate logistic regression to assess the association between resident involvement and prolonged length of stay (>4 days), stratified by quarter.
Result· Resident involvement was associated with prolonged length of stay overall, but no additional July effect was observed in quarter 3.
Validation· Statistical adjustment for comorbidities and other confounders in a large national database.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate the effect of thread lead design on insertion torque and primary stability of dental implants.
Method· Single, double, and triple thread implants were inserted into bovine bone blocks; insertion torque, resonance frequency analysis, and removal torque were measured.
Result· Triple thread implants exhibited the highest primary stability and removal torque but the lowest insertion torque.
Validation· Ex vivo experiments on fresh bovine bone were conducted.

Exclude Hip Implant & Femoral Stem openalex Peripheral Ignore none Review

单位: International Deformity and Lengthening Inst, Chaudhary Hospital, Akola, India

相关性: 该论文讨论膝关节高位胫骨截骨术，与髋关节植入物和股骨柄的应力遮挡、微动及有限元分析无关。
边界: This paper focuses on high tibial osteotomy for knee osteoarthritis, not on hip implant stress shielding, micromotion, or femoral stem biomechanics.
动机· 更新膝内翻畸形高位胫骨截骨术的选择算法
方法· 回顾不同截骨技术的历史与并发症，提出分类更新

验证· 无验证，为综述性社论
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To update the algorithm for selecting high tibial osteotomy techniques based on deformity location and severity.
Method· A narrative review of historical and current HTO techniques, their complications, and indications.
Result· The paper proposes a refined classification to guide personalized osteotomy choice.
Validation· No experimental validation; this is an editorial review.

Minimum 2-Year Outcomes of All-Arthroscopic Capsular Autograft Labral Reconstruction

Exclude Hip Implant & Femoral Stem openalex Peripheral Ignore clinical
Michael P. Kucharik, Paul F. Abraham, Mark R. Nazal, Nathan H. Varady, Wendy M. Meek et al. Orthopaedic Journal of Sports Medicine 2021-07-01 10.1177/2325967121s00242
单位: Massachusetts General Hospital, Division of Sports Medicine, Massachusetts General Hospital
通讯: Michael P. Kucharik @ Massachusetts General Hospital, Division of Sports Medicine, Massachusetts General Hospital
相关性: 该论文讨论的是髋关节镜下的关节囊自体移植物盂唇重建的临床结果，未涉及股骨柄假体或应力遮挡等生物力学建模。
边界: This paper reports clinical outcomes of a surgical technique for labral reconstruction, with no finite element analysis, no implant mechanics, no stress shielding or micromotion quantification, and no contact mechanics modeling.
动机· 评估全关节镜下关节囊自体移植物盂唇重建术的两年以上临床结果。
方法· 回顾性病例系列，收集72例患者术后至少2年的患者报告结果。
结果· 平均随访30.3个月，患者报告结果改善，但无生物力学数据。
验证· 临床随访验证，无生物力学或有限元验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To report minimum 2-year outcomes of all-arthroscopic capsular autograft labral reconstruction, a novel technique for complex labral tears.
Method· Retrospective case series of 72 hips (69 patients) undergoing the procedure, with prospective collection of patient-reported outcome measures at multiple time points.
Result· At mean 30.3-month follow-up, significant improvements in patient-reported outcomes were observed, with no biomechanical or implant-related data.
Validation· Clinical follow-up validation only; no mechanical testing, finite element analysis, or implant modeling was performed.
